description: Grade an agent's structured outcome against owner-written fixtures (word/phrase groups) -- an asset check attached to the agent's own outcome asset, reporting recall/precision as metadata.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: The agent's outcome asset to attach this check to (e.g. 'improvement_advisor_outcome').

fixtures_file.label: Fixtures File
fixtures_file.description: Path to a JSON fixtures file: {"fixtures": [{"id": "...", "any": [["word", "word"], [...]]}]}. A finding matches a fixture when it contains every word of AT LEAST ONE of its `any` groups (case-insensitive substring match). Relative paths resolve against this component's own defs.yaml directory.

min_recall.label: Min Recall
min_recall.description: Minimum recall (matched fixtures / total fixtures) to pass.

severity.label: Severity
severity.description: Check severity when recall is below min_recall.

check_name.label: Check Name
check_name.description: Name of the emitted asset check.

findings_keys.label: Findings Keys
findings_keys.description: Top-level keys of the outcome dict holding lists of {title, body} (or similarly-shaped) findings dicts -- default covers both a real filing and a practice-mode 'would file' record. Every listed key's entries are pooled together.

fallback_text_key.label: Fallback Text Key
fallback_text_key.description: Top-level key of the outcome dict used as the only evidence when no findings_keys entries exist at all (e.g. practice mode matched nothing, or a tool-less agent's final note).

description.label: Description
description.description: Check description. Defaults to a generated one naming the fixtures file and threshold.

match_mode.label: Match Mode
match_mode.description: 'text' (default, unchanged): pools {title, body} free-text findings and matches them against word-group fixtures (see fixtures_file). 'fields': grades structured extraction output instead -- the outcome's fields_key holds a flat {field_name: value} dict (e.g. document-extraction output), compared field-by-field against fixtures_file entries shaped {"id": "...", "field": "...", "expected": ...} using fuzzy string/numeric matching (see fuzzy_field_threshold, numeric_tolerance).

fields_key.label: Fields Key
fields_key.description: Top-level key of the outcome dict holding the extracted field_name -> value dict. Only used when match_mode is 'fields'.

fuzzy_field_threshold.label: Fuzzy Field Threshold
fuzzy_field_threshold.description: Minimum text-similarity ratio (0-1) for a string field to count as matching its fixture's expected value, in 'fields' mode. Computed with a token-sort ratio (word order ignored, case-insensitive) over Python's stdlib difflib.SequenceMatcher -- e.g. 'Acme Corp' vs 'Acme Corporation' scores 0.72, above the 0.7 default, while a genuinely different value scores well below it. Only used when match_mode is 'fields'.

numeric_tolerance.label: Numeric Tolerance
numeric_tolerance.description: Relative tolerance for a numeric field to count as matching its fixture's expected value, in 'fields' mode -- e.g. 0.01 means within 1% (so 1042.50 matches an expected 1042.51, but not an expected 950.00). Passed as math.isclose's rel_tol. Only used when match_mode is 'fields'.
